message: PctGroup (libs/components/widget/src/group.ts) binds `[innerHTML]` in its host block
$reason: The reference's group binding `[innerHtml]` in its host block, which the compiler maps to `innerHTML` (measured: `ɵɵdomProperty("innerHTML", …, ɵɵsanitizeHtml)`), so it draws its options into the component's own element from a string. That markup is no more the tree's than a template's `[innerHTML]` is, and point 1 refuses it the same way. No count of the text ever read a host block.
